posts.title: Perihelion: Chapter 2
posts.description: Eleven minutes from quarters to the bridge of the Daedalus, if I don't rush – and I never do – on OOD mornings. I look forward to the drive. posts.description: Just passed the lunch rush down at the base cafeteria. I sit down alone at a bench with my meal, back to the wall out of habit.
